hook.text: Its themes draw on the Dollars trilogy and Seven Samurai, and the title is a metaphor for avoiding difficult topics.

sentences.text: Curry began thinking about the album's themes in 2018, and started work on it after finishing Zuu, his 2019 album.
His first collaboration with Kenny Beats, the EP Unlocked, came out on 7 February 2020.
Curry told XXL in 2020 that he planned to retire from music after three more full-length releases.
The album also moved away from older alter egos, and he wanted the music to show who he is and how he feels.
The title's second half, See Your Future, is about moving on and putting the past behind.
Producers include Cardo, FnZ, Thundercat, JPEGMafia and Kenny Beats, among others.
Guests include Robert Glasper, T-Pain, JID, 6lack and Slowthai.
Four tracks contain samples of other recordings, including Walkin and Zatoichi.
Nathan Burgess handled mixing and engineering, and Chris Gehringer mastered the record.
The extended version was preceded by a Key Glock remix of Walkin, released on 1 June 2022.
On 30 September 2022 the extended edition came out with ten new songs that Curry recorded with the Cold Blooded Soul Band.
It also added two songs that had not been released before, Larger Than Life and Chrome Hearts, the second featuring Zacari.
A livestream concert, Melt My Eyez: Live From the Komodo City Cafe, aired the day before to help promote it.

listen_for.text: A sample of The Loving Touch runs through it, a song Keith Mansfield wrote and performed.
Robert Glasper plays the keyboards on it, and he is the featured guest.
It samples Come Closer, which Salma Agha performed, and Anna Wise adds extra vocals.
It samples Nothing Left to Do by After All, and Sharina Castillo adds extra vocals.
